scenario: I am planning a relaxing getaway to Barcelona from April 10th to April 20th. I would love to fly out from New York on April 10th, and it's important for me to have a meal onboard as it makes the journey feel more like home. I also appreciate having a bit more personal space and privacy, so I plan to fly business class to enjoy some exclusive amenities. Upon arrival in Barcelona, I will be staying in an apartment from April 10th to April 20th. I envision spending my evenings having a little barbecue in a garden right at my apartment, which seems like the perfect way to unwind. Additionally, I love to catch up on a good book in the comfort of my room, so I would appreciate the option to check out late on April 20th to savor the last moments of my trip.
